name: How do you fix a leaky roof temporarily?

mainEntity.name: How do you fix a leaky roof temporarily?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apply roofing cement under lifted shingles; use peel-and-stick ice/water shield patches; tarp large areas secured with 1x3 boards screwed down.

description: Apply roofing cement under lifted shingles; use peel-and-stick ice/water shield patches; tarp large areas secured with 1x3 boards screwed down.
